item.title: Data Acquisition Worker Service
item.description: The Data Acquisition Worker is a .NET background service that listens on the ReadyToAcquire Kafka topic and processes queued data acquisition logs to fetch FHIR resources for a facility.

item.title: Query Dispatch Service
